title: Derelict
subtitle: Adrift aboard the cargo hauler Marigold
description: Sci-fi adventure. Wake up alone on an abandoned ship and find a way off.
author: Daniel Sandner
default_hint: Look at everything, read everything, and talk to anyone who will answer.
help: Goal: get off the ship. 'journal' shows what you are working on.
about: A demo adventure for the CLIo engine: puzzles, dialogue trees, quests, one tactical fight and three endings.
